<project_context>
# 项目: symb_invariant_consensus

## 运行环境
- 服务器名: westd-32608
- SSH 账户: root（调用 ssh_execute / submit_training_job 时传入 account="root"）
- SSH 连接命令: ssh connect.westd.seetacloud.com  # 必须用此命令，~/.ssh/config 自动应用密钥和跳板机，禁止用裸 IP
- 项目代码根目录: /root/symb_invariant_consensus


## 环境搭建
连接服务器后先调 `detect_image` 检测是否为预置镜像。如果匹配，跳过基础环境搭建，只装项目特有依赖。已预装的包不要重复安装。

## 输出风格
回复简洁直接。只输出执行结果和必要信息，不要解释过程、不要客套、不要给未被要求的建议。
</project_context>
## 任务
为 exp-019 创建 LLaMA-8B StrategyQA 200 题实验脚本，使 exp-010 完成后可立即启动。

## 背景
exp-011 在 LLaMA-3.1-8B 上 SICA +6.67pp (66.7% vs 60.0%)，但 n=60 underpowered (p=0.22)。需要扩大到 n=200 做 powered test。StrategyQA 是 Yes/No 常识推理任务。

## 配置要求
- 模型：LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct（路径待确认，可能在 /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/ 或 /root/autodl-tmp/models/）
- 数据：StrategyQA 200 题（检查 /root/symb_invariant_consensus/data/ 是否已有 strategyqa 数据，若无则需要下载/准备）
- K=12, T=0.7
- max-model-len=8192, max-tokens=4096（不能相同！）
- gpu-memory-utilization=0.90
- seed=42
- port=8000

## 具体步骤
1. SSH 到 westd-32608 (root@)，确认环境：
   - `source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base`
   - 确认 LLaMA-8B 模型路径（`find /root -name "Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct" -type d 2>/dev/null`）
   
2. 检查 StrategyQA 数据是否已有 200 题子集：
   - 查看 `/root/symb_invariant_consensus/data/` 目录
   - 如果已有 strategyqa_200 或类似 → 用现有的
   - 如果只有 60 题子集 → 需要准备 200 题数据集
   - 参考 exp-017 的 StrategyQA 脚本了解数据格式

3. 参考现有脚本：
   - `/root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp011_llama8b.sh`（LLaMA-8B 设置）
   - `/root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp017_strategyqa.sh`（StrategyQA 设置）
   - 合并两者：LLaMA-8B 模型 + StrategyQA 数据 + 200 题

4. 写 `/root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp019_strategyqa_200.sh`：
   ```bash
   #!/bin/bash
   set -e
   echo "=== exp-019: LLaMA-8B StrategyQA 200 ==="
   echo "Start: $(date)"
   
   # 清理残留 vLLM
   echo "Cleaning up existing vLLM..."
   pkill -9 -f "vllm.entrypoints" 2>/dev/null || true
   sleep 5
   nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader
   
   # 启动 LLaMA-8B vLLM
   python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
       --model <LLAMA_PATH> \
       --port 8000 \
       --max-model-len 8192 \
       --max-num-seqs 64 \
       --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
       --trust-remote-code \
       > /tmp/vllm_exp019.log 2>&1 &
   VLLM_PID=$!
   
   # 等待就绪
   for i in $(seq 1 90); do
       if curl -s http://localhost:8000/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
           echo "vLLM ready after ${i}s"
           break
       fi
       sleep 2
   done
   
   # 运行 SICA
   python scripts/run_full_mvp.py \
       --dataset strategyqa \
       --data-path <DATA_PATH> \
       --n-problems 200 \
       --K 12 \
       --temperature 0.7 \
       --max-tokens 4096 \
       --seed 42 \
       --output-dir results/exp019_strategyqa_200/ \
       --port 8000
   
   EXIT_CODE=$?
   kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
   echo "EXIT_CODE=$EXIT_CODE"
   ```
   
5. 如果数据不存在（只有 60 题），需要准备 200 题：
   - 查看 StrategyQA 的完整数据集来源
   - 可能在 HuggingFace datasets 或本地已有更大文件
   - 确保格式与 exp-017 一致

6. `chmod +x` + `bash -n` 验证

## 产出
- `/root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp019_strategyqa_200.sh`（完整可运行）
- 确认 200 题数据是否就绪（如果需要下载则报告）
- 模型路径确认

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

# exp-011: LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct SICA evaluation (cross-family validation)
# D012: 30 FOLIO + 30 ProofWriter D5, K=12, T=0.7, max_tokens=8192
# Claim 2 cross-model-family validation (non-Qwen architecture)
set -e
cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct"
PORT=8002
RESULTS_DIR="results/exp011_llama8b"
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR"

# Clean up ANY existing vLLM processes (e.g. residual Qwen-14B occupying GPU)
echo "Cleaning up any existing vLLM processes..."
pkill -9 -f "vllm.entrypoints" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 5
# Verify GPU is freed
echo "GPU status after cleanup:"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader

# Step 1: Start vLLM in background
echo "=== [$(date)] Starting vLLM (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct) on port $PORT ==="
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL" \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \

        break

    if ! kill -0 $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "ERROR: vLLM process died. Check /tmp/vllm_exp011.log"
        cat /tmp/vllm_exp011.log | tail -20
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

if ! curl -s http://localhost:$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: vLLM did not start within 180s"
    kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null
    exit 1
fi

# Step 3: Run SICA pipeline
echo "=== [$(date)] Running SICA pipeline: K=12, T=0.7, 60 problems ==="
python3 run_full_mvp.py \
    --mode vllm \
    --k 12 \
    --temperature 0.7 \
    --max-tokens 4096 \
    --api-base "http://localhost:$PORT/v1" \
    --math-data data/empty.json \
    --pw-data data/proofwriter_30.json \
    --folio-data data/folio_30.json \
    --output "$RESULTS_DIR/exp011_results.json" \
    --save-intermediates \
    --seed 42

# Step 4: Cleanup
echo "=== [$(date)] Stopping vLLM ==="
kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
echo "EXP011_DONE"

cat > /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp019_strategyqa_200.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# exp-019: LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct StrategyQA 200 (powered replication of exp-011)
# exp-011 showed SICA +6.67pp on n=60 (p=0.22, underpowered)
# This exp: n=200 for proper statistical power
# K=12, T=0.7, max-tokens=4096, seed=42
set -e
cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/models/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct"
PORT=8000
RESULTS_DIR="results/exp019_strategyqa_200"
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR"

echo "=== exp-019: LLaMA-8B StrategyQA 200 ==="
echo "Start: $(date)"

# Clean up ANY existing vLLM processes
echo "Cleaning up any existing vLLM processes..."
pkill -9 -f "vllm.entrypoints" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 5
echo "GPU status after cleanup:"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader

# Step 1: Start vLLM (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct)
echo "=== [$(date)] Starting vLLM (LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct) on port $PORT ==="
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL" \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
    --port $PORT \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --dtype auto > /tmp/vllm_exp019.log 2>&1 &
VLLM_PID=$!
echo "vLLM PID: $VLLM_PID"

# Step 2: Wait for vLLM ready (up to 180s)
echo "Waiting for vLLM to be ready..."
for i in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl -s http://localhost:$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "vLLM ready after ${i}s"
        break
    fi
    if ! kill -0 $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "ERROR: vLLM process died. Check /tmp/vllm_exp019.log"
        tail -20 /tmp/vllm_exp019.log
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

if ! curl -s http://localhost:$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: vLLM did not start within 180s"
    kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null
    exit 1
fi

# Step 3: Run SICA vs SC evaluation on 200 StrategyQA problems
echo "=== [$(date)] Running exp-019: StrategyQA, K=12, T=0.7, 200 problems ==="
python3 scripts/eval_strategyqa.py \
    --mode vllm \
    --k 12 \
    --n-problems 200 \
    --temperature 0.7 \
    --max-tokens 4096 \
    --api-base "http://localhost:$PORT/v1" \
    --model auto \
    --seed 42 \
    --data data/strategyqa_200.json \
    --output "$RESULTS_DIR/exp019_results.json" \
    --save-intermediates

EXIT_CODE=$?

# Step 4: Cleanup
echo "=== [$(date)] Stopping vLLM ==="
kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
echo "End: $(date)"
echo "EXIT_CODE=$EXIT_CODE"
echo "EXP019_DONE"
EOF
chmod +x /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp019_strategyqa_200.sh
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && bash -n /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp019_strategyqa_200.sh && echo "SYNTAX_OK"
